all.description: When true, returns all available sports. When false or omitted, returns only recently updated (in-season) sports.

function.name: v4_sports_sport_odds
function.description: Retrieves live and upcoming games with bookmaker odds for a specified sport or across all sports. Returns game details including bookmaker-specific odds formatted by market type. Use this function to get real-time betting data from supported regions and bookmakers.

sport.description: Sport key identifying the sport to query (e.g., 'basketball_nba'). Use 'upcoming' to retrieve the next 8 upcoming games across all sports. Sport keys must match those returned by the /sports endpoint.

regions.description: Comma-separated list of regions to filter bookmakers (e.g., 'us,uk'). Each region will count as 1 request against your API quota. See documentation for region-bookmaker mappings.

oddsformat.description: Format for returned odds values. Select a standardized odds format.

markets.description: Comma-separated list of odds markets to include (e.g., 'h2h,outrights'). Each market will count as 1 request against your API quota. Common markets include 'h2h' (head-to-head), 'spreads', and 'totals'.

dateformat.description: Format for returned timestamps in game data.

function.name: v4_sports_sport_scores
function.description: Retrieves live, upcoming, and optionally recent completed games with scores for a specified sport. Currently in beta for select sports; refer to the [sports list](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/sports-apis.html) for available options.

sport.description: Sport key identifying the specific sport to retrieve game data for. Must match a supported sport key from the API's available sports list.

daysfrom.description: Optional number of days in the past (valid values: 1-3) to include completed games in the response. If omitted, only live and upcoming games are included.

function.name: calculate_etf
function.description: Calculates the theoretical equity asset percentage change for a leveraged ETF based on its leverage factor and the underlying asset's percentage change. This function is useful for financial analysis of leveraged investment products.

leverage.description: The ETF's leverage factor relative to the underlying asset (e.g., 2 for 2x leverage, 3 for 3x leverage). This determines how strongly the ETF responds to the underlying asset's movements.

underlying.description: The percentage change of the underlying asset as a whole number (e.g., 5 for 5%, -2 for -2%). This represents the base asset's performance before applying leverage.

function.name: leveraged_equity_calculator
function.description: Calculates the projected equity value after a price change for a leveraged investment. This function helps analyze leveraged ETF performance by quantifying the impact of leverage on equity growth or decline based on underlying asset price movements.

leverage.description: The leverage multiplier applied to the investment. For example, 2 for 2x leverage. Higher values amplify both gains and losses.

originalshareprice.description: The initial price of the underlying asset before the price change. Must be a positive integer.

originalequity.description: The initial investment amount at the start of the period. Must be a positive integer.

projectedshareprice.description: The expected future price of the underlying asset. Must be a positive integer.

function.name: get_race
function.description: Retrieves detailed race results and classification data for cycling competitions. Returns information about race winners, standings, and category-specific classifications. Use this function to analyze race outcomes or obtain historical performance data.

racecategory.description: Race category (e.g., Grand Tour, Classic, Stage Race) - valid values can be obtained from the GET Races endpoint. This defines the classification structure and race type.

race.description: Identifier for the specific race within the category (e.g., 'Tour de France', 'Giro d'Italia'). Must be a valid race name for the specified category.

afterstage.description: Stage number after which to retrieve classification data. Valid values are positive integers up to the total number of stages in the race. Omitting returns overall classification.

year.description: Year of the race (e.g., '2023'). If not specified, defaults to the current year.

classification.description: Type of classification data to retrieve. Valid options include GC (General Classification), Points, KOM (King of Mountains), Youth, Teams, and Stage.

function.name: get_races
function.description: Retrieves UCI cycling races based on category and year. Returns comprehensive race data including dates, locations, classifications, and event details.

category.description: Race category filter to specify type of events (e.g., professional tours, championships, regional circuits)

year.description: Filter races by calendar year (4-digit format, e.g., '2023'). When omitted, defaults to current year data.

function.name: get_riders

year.description: Optional four-digit year (e.g., '2023') to filter cyclists active during a specific season. When omitted, returns cyclists across all available historical records.

function.name: get_teams
function.description: Retrieves comprehensive data about all UCI-registered professional cycling teams for a specified season. year.description: Season year to retrieve data for, formatted as 'YYYY'. If not specified, defaults to current season data.

function.description: Retrieves upcoming and live football (soccer) and tennis matches with optional filtering by sport, date range, and competition. Returns match details including teams/players, scheduled time, venue, and current status.

sport.description: Sport to filter matches. If not specified, returns matches for both football and tennis.

start_date.description: Return matches starting after this date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-03-20T15:00:00Z'). Default is the current date and time.

end_date.description: Return matches starting before this date and time in ISO 8601 format. Default is 7 days after the start_date.

competition.description: Name of the competition to filter matches (e.g., 'Premier League' or 'Wimbledon'). Case-insensitive partial matches are supported.

live_only.description: If true, return only matches currently in progress. Defaults to false.

function.name: class_2_0
function.description: Classifies multilingual text content into standardized categories using specified models. Supports classification in multiple languages and taxonomies (IPTC, EUROVOC, Business Reports) with optional filtering by category prefixes. Accepts input text, URLs, or abstracts for analysis.

model.description: Classification model to use. Determines the language and taxonomy of categories. Valid models include: IPTC language variants (es/en/ca/pt/it/fr), EUROVOC multilingual (EUROVOC_es_ca), and business report models (BusinessRep_es/BusinessRepShort_es).

abstract.description: Alternative input content to classify. Can be plain text, HTML, or XML (UTF-8 encoded). Required if 'txt' and 'url' are empty.

expand_hierarchy.description: Whether to include parent categories in the hierarchy. Accepts 'true' or 'false' (case-insensitive). Default is 'false'.

of.description: Output format for the response. Valid values are 'json' or 'xml'.

txt.description: Primary input text to classify. Can be plain text, HTML, or XML (UTF-8 encoded). Required if 'url' and 'abstract' are empty.

url.description: Public URL containing content to classify. Supports HTTP/FTP with no authentication required. Supported content types: plain text, HTML, XML.

title.description: Descriptive title of the content. Terms in the title have higher classification weight. Can be plain text, HTML, or XML (UTF-8 encoded).

verbose.description: Whether to enable verbose mode to show additional classification details. Accepts 'true' or 'false' (case-insensitive). Default is 'false'.

categories.description: Pipe-separated list of category prefixes to filter results. Only categories starting with these prefixes will be returned (e.g., '0800' for human interest).

function.name: players
function.description: Retrieves data about top international male goal scorers by nation (up to 2023). Returns player statistics including goals, matches played, and national team information.

nation.description: Filter results by country name (e.g., 'Brazil', 'Germany') or 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., 'BRA', 'GER')

year.description: Filter results to show goal scorers up to a specific year (valid range: 1900-2023)

player_name.description: Search for a specific player by full name (case-insensitive partial matches supported)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (valid range: 1-100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

function.description: Fetches the id, name, and country of all players from the Valorant esports API based on the provided filtering criteria.

minrounds.description: Minimum rounds a player has to have played.

limit.description: Limit the number of players returned.

function.name: profile_info
function.description: Retrieves profile information from Instagram using the Toolbench RapidAPI.

username.description: The Instagram username for which profile information is to be retrieved. Defaults to 'kimkardashian'.

function.name: languages
function.description: Fetches a list of ISO 639 languages, optionally filtered by a name substring.

lang_3.description: Filter by 3-letter ISO language code. Defaults to None.

fields.description: Select fields to include in the result (e.g., 'iso_a2,lang_3,flag'). Defaults to 'iso_a2,lang_3,flag'.

lang.description: Language code to translate the results into. Defaults to 'en'.

function.name: three_hourly
function.description: Fetches a three-hourly weather forecast for a given location up to 14 days, with optional historical data and various configurable parameters.

location.description: The location for which to fetch the weather forecast.

history.description: Whether to include 24 hours of past data. Defaults to None.

tz.description: Time zone in the response, specified using IANA time zone database names. Defaults to 'Europe/London'.

dataset.description: The variable set to use in the response. Defaults to 'full'.

tempunit.description: The temperature unit in the response (e.g., 'C' for Celsius). Defaults to 'C'.

alt.description: The altitude in meters. Defaults to 0.

periods.description: The number of time steps in the response, with a default of 8 and a maximum of 12. Defaults to 8.

windunit.description: The wind speed unit in the response (e.g., 'MS' for meters per second). Defaults to 'MS'.
